name: Stormers and Rumblers
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
We, the elementals of water, wage war with those beings of the lesser elements.  If you are truly our ally in this conflict, then show me your conviction!

Far to the south, in the desert land of Silithus, the servants of air and earth scurry in a corner of rock named the Crystal Vale.  They protect items of power from smaller beings, mortals, and although I do not know why they do this, I wish to foil their efforts.

Go to the Crystal Vale in Silithus and defeat our enemies, then return to me.
narrative.objectives: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
narrative.offerRewardText: Your bravery is proven, as is your worth to us.  Perhaps I may have future tasks for you, tasks more befitting a valued ally of the Waterlords.
narrative.requestItemsText: Cowardice is not a thing we hold in regard, champion.  Go to Silithus and prove your bravery.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 57 to 60, 54,100 XP in all.

quests.name: Stormers and Rumblers
quests.objectiveText: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: Eye of the Emberseer
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: The Molten Core
quests.objectiveText: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: Agent of Hydraxis
quests.objectiveText: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: Hands of the Enemy
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: A Hero's Reward
quests.objectiveText: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.
